summary.en:
- Ashveil is a strong crit-based DPS who excels in ST scenarios but is also decent in AoE, as his enhanced follow-up attack (FuA) changes targets when it kills an enemy.
- Supportive capabilities designed to benefit FuA units, including DEF Reduction and CRIT DMG buffs.
 -His kit is intended for a sub-DPS role alongside Aventurine • Waveflair, although he works just fine as a hypercarry.

details.en:
E1: Increases DMG taken by enemies by 24%. When an enemy is below 50% health, this increases to 36% (provides more value if Ashveil is a sub-DPS).
- His S1 [[light-cone:the-finale-of-a-lie]] provides 18% CR. Grants 40% ATK and applies 20% Vulnerability to all enemies at the start of the battle and for every 4 instances of FuA.
- E2: Increases maximum Gluttony to 18 and refunds 35% of consumed Gluttony after an enhanced FuA.
